buyer_added_terms.text: 1. Generic OPTION CLAUSE 50% : The buyer can increase or decrease the contract quantity or contract duration up to 50 percent at the time of issue of the contract. However, once the contract is issued, the contract quantity or contract duration can only be increased up to 50 percent. Bidders are bound to accept the revised quantity or duration. For lumpsum-based service contracts, the buyer may increase the scope of work and contract value up to 50 percent with the consent of the service provider

2. Generic Bidder financial standing: The bidder should not be under liquidation, court receivership or similar proceedings, should not be bankrupt. Bidder to upload undertaking to this effect with bid. 3. Forms of EMD and PBG Bidders can also submit the EMD with Account Payee Demand Draft in favour of Sports Authority of India, Aurangabad payable at Aurangabad . Bidder has to upload scanned copy / proof of the DD along with bid and has to ensure delivery of hardcopy to the Buyer within 5 days of Bid End date / Bid Opening date. 4. Certificates Bidder's offer is liable to be rejected if they don't upload any of the certificates / documents sought in the Bid document, ATC and Corrigendum if any. 5. Service & Support AVAILABILITY OF OFFICE OF SERVICE PROVIDER: An office of the Service Provider must be located in the state of Consignee. DOCUMENTARY EVIDENCE TO BE SUBMITTED. 6. Service & Support Dedicated /toll Free Telephone No. for Service Support : BIDDER/OEM must have Dedicated/toll Free Telephone No. for Service Support. 7. Purchase Preference (State) Bid reserved for MSE from the State of Bid Inviting Authority: Procurement under this bid is reserved for purchase from Micro and Small Enterprises from the State of Bid Inviting Authority having valid Udyam Registration and whose credentials are validated online through Udyam Registration portal. If the bidder wants to avail themselves of the reservation benefit, the bidder must be the manufacturer / OEM of the offered product on GeM. Traders are excluded from the purview of Public Procurement Policy for Micro and Small Enterprises and hence resellers offering products manufactured by some other OEM are not eligible to participate in this bid. In respect of bid for Services, the bidder must be the Service provider of the offered Service. Relevant documentary evidence in this regard shall be uploaded along with the bid in respect of the offered product or service, and Buyer will decide eligibility based on documentary evidence submitted, while evaluating the bid. Benefits of MSE will be allowed only if seller is validated on-line in GeM profile as well as validated and approved by Buyer after evaluation of documents submitted. 8. Payment PAYMENT OF SALARIES AND WAGES: Service Provider is required to pay Salaries / wages of contracted staff deployed at buyer location first i.e. on their own and then claim payment from Buyer alongwith all statutory documents like, PF, ESIC etc. as well as the bank statement of payment done to staff. 9. Past Project Experience Proof for Past Experience and Project Experience clause: For fulfilling the experience criteria any one of the following documents may be considered as valid proof for meeting the experience criteria:a. Contract copy along with Invoice(s) with self-certification by the bidder that service/supplies against the invoices have been executed.b. Execution certificate by client with contract value.c. Any other document in support of contract execution like Third Party Inspection release note, etc.Proof for Past Experience and Project Experience clause: For fulfilling the experience criteria any one of the following documents may be considered as valid proof for meeting the experience criteria:a. certificate by client with contract value.c. Any other document in support of contract execution like Third Party Inspection release note, etc. 10. Buyer Added Bid Specific ATC Buyer Added text based ATC clauses Terms and conditions: 1) Service provider is required to pay salaries / wages of contracted staff de ployed at buyer location first i.e. on their own which can be up to three m onths and then claim payment from buyer along with all statutory docum ents like PF, ESIC challan PT etc. as well as the bank statement of salary t o staff along with salary slip. The service provider should not make any ot her deductions such as contribution to society, caution deposit etc other t han the statutory deductions 2) Bidder should have its Geographic Presence: The bidders should have a r egistered office situated in the state of Maharashtra, near to SAI NCOE Ch hatrapati Sambhajinagar i.e. in Municipal Corporation of Chhatrapati Sam bhajinagar or District Chhatrapati Sambhajinagar. 3 ) The bidder shall submit the following documents for verification by the Buyer and upload the same along with the bid so as to verified the geogra phic presence. i. Electricity Bills for the last three months; ii. Valid Online / offline Registration, Leave and Licence Agreement; iii. No Objection Certificate (NOC) from the landlord on a non-judicial stamp paper/bond; and iv. Municipal Tax Receipts for the last one years. Submission of the above documents is mandatory. Failure to furnish any of the aforesaid documen ts may render the bid liable for rejection. 4) The bidder should provide contract labour license for providing Horticult ure service as per the CLRA Act 1950 from Shram Suvidha portal or Mahar ashtra Contract labour (regulation and Abolition) Act, 1971. They should s ubmit copy of Shram Suvidha CLC Annual Return in case of CLRA Act 1950. 5) Copy of the Annual Turnover Certificate for the last three (03) financial years, duly certified by a Chartered Accountant an average annual turnov er certificate of not less than Rs. 1.35 crore (Rupees One Crore Thirty -Five Lakhs Only). 6) Bidder must ensure the submission of horticulture Gardner / mali work o rder only from any of the PSU/State / Central Government organizations. 7) Bidder must ensure the submission of horticulture Gardner / mali work c ompletion certificate only from any of the PSU/State / Central Government organizations. 8) Solvency certificate minimum 37-00lakhs from nationalized bank (not a bove six month) as on the last date of submission of the bid. 9) Should furnish valid ISO-9001 certificate for providing Horticulture manp ower services

10) Should have minimum 3 years’ experience in providing Horticulture / ga rdening manpower services 11) Should submit minimum wages compliance certificate from the current client stating that the contractor is paying wages in accordance with mini mum wages notified by the Chief Labour Commissioner Central to the em ployees engaged in various day-to-day activities. 12) Should submit proof of remittance of ESIC, PF, GST etc. 13) Should have registered under GST Act. 14) ITR for past 03 years along with balance sheet and profit & loss stateme nt (FY. 2022-23, 2023-24 and 2024-25) 15) Current client list with contract value details. 16) The service provider is required to have previous evidence of having hor ticulture comparable manpower deployment experience for at least one y ear. Necessary documents relating to such Housekeeping service will be u ploaded by the bidder for verification of the buyer. 17) Undertaking regarding not blacklisted or debarred by any Govt. entity (f ormat enclosed) 18) Successful bidder needs to provide police verification certificate, medic al fitness certificate and address proof of the engaging manpower to SAI, NCOE Chh. Sambhajinagar. 19) The successful bidder needs to mandatory provide uniform to the engag ing manpower to SAI, NCOE Chhatrapati Sambhajinagar. 20) The selected vendor is required to retain the existing resource currently employed by the previous agency and ensure their continuation at their r espective workplaces. Any new resources, if engaged through the agency will be through the selection committee of NCOE Chhatrapati Sambhajinagar. 21) The bidder / contractor submission of a copy of the valid licence along with the bid is mandatory, under the provisions of the Occupational Safety, Health and Working Conditions Code, 2020 and the rules, re gulations, bye-laws, standards, notifications, or orders made or issued the reunder by the Competent Authority. Failure to furnish the requisite licenc e as applicable, shall render the bid liable to be rejected. 22) The Code on Wages, 2019, employer shall pay minimum rates wages notified by central government to employees before the expiry of the sev enth day of the succeeding month, the Code safeguards employees’ inter ests through universal minimum wages, ensuring dignity and timely paym ent of wages.

23) Successful bidders are required to install biometric machine for attenda nce at the campus and must submit biometric attendance along with the bill is mandatory for payment. . 11. Buyer Added Bid Specific ATC Buyer uploaded ATC document Click here to view the file.
